tagline: The FL Evolution league newsletter · est. 2019
headline: brettmn13 Ends Jbird531's Unbeaten Run, and butterygoop Moves to First
dek: The 1-6 champion beats the 6-0 team in a rematch of the 2024 final, butterygoop is still above the median every week, and Monday night flips YoungBuck04 past Wallner. Plus Colt45Johnson's 142, a free agent who would have flipped two games, and the injury list.
lead:
Monday night touched three games and flipped one. Wallner led YoungBuck04 106.60 to 82.30 going into it, and YoungBuck04 won 119.28 to 113.90.

The bigger result came on Sunday. brettmn13, winless through six weeks, beat Jbird531 92.54 to 78.66 in a rematch of the 2024 final. He did it while scoring under the week's median of 113.31; Jbird531 got 7.7 from Kenneth Walker and 1.6 from Nico Collins. That leaves butterygoop alone in first at 6-1 on points, and still the only team besides triccster to clear the median in all seven weeks. butterygoop has started 6-1 three times before, in 2019, 2020 and 2021, and won the title all three times.

managers.text: Beat thecreamer 119.84 to 112.72 for a third straight win, behind CeeDee Lamb (21.9), Jonathan Taylor (18.0) and Braelon Allen (16.4). Isaiah Likely started and scored 2.2, and Tre Tucker had 18.8 on the bench. Taylor has 129.0 started points since the preseason trade. He leads the league in points (1,024.64) and has beaten Sleeper's projections by 72.1, the most of anyone. Josh Jacobs made his 2026 debut on Sunday, and Lamar Jackson ran onto the practice field Wednesday after missing three games.
managers.next: Week 8: TuanonStan, who leads the series 5-3 and won last year's meeting. butterygoop is a 75% favorite.

managers.text: Lost 92.54 to 78.66 to brettmn13, his lowest score of the season. Walker and Collins together came up 32.5 points short of their averages in a 13.88-point loss. KC Concepcion scored 19.2 on the bench; the rookie has 47.9 points this year, third among rookies behind Denzel Boston, also his, at 67.2. Jordan Love (16.96) and Bijan Robinson (14.7) led the lineup. Still 6-1, and the model's title favorite at 38%.
managers.next: Week 8: YoungBuck04, a rematch of last year's semifinal, which Jbird531 won 132.32 to 111.46. He is a 76% favorite.

managers.text: Scored 120.62, above the median, and lost by 21.58 to Colt45Johnson in the game of the week. Zay Flowers (23.7), Jared Goff (18.02) and Puka Nacua (17.8) led it; Darius Cooper started and scored 2.2. Nacua has 81.2 started points in four games since the three-firsts trade, and the team is 3-1 since. He leads the Coach of the year race at 93% lineup efficiency and claimed Samaje Perine for $5 this week. Saquon Barkley came back on Monday night, then tweaked the hamstring and picked up a back issue. His only other 5-2 start, in 2021, made the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 8: RebuildingRUs, who won last year's consolation game 96.64 to 75.08. triccster leads the series 4-1 and is a 68% favorite.

managers.text: Beat DMsourbeer 95.68 to 76.30 behind Geno Smith (23.48), Ollie Gordon (16.8) and Malik Nabers (14.6), with Blake Corum scoring 16.6 on the bench. His best start in this league by two wins, and he has done it with only two weeks above the median. Kittle, Olave and Nabers are all on bye in week 8: three pieces to replace.
managers.next: Week 8: brettmn13, the game of the week. brettmn13 has won the last four meetings, but TrifectaRich is a 58% favorite.

managers.text: Set the best lineup of the week, 98% of his possible points, and lost 125.06 to 107.52 to RebuildingRUs anyway. Malik Willis (26.02), Christian McCaffrey (19.0) and Ashton Jeanty (17.6) led it; Deshaun Watson scored 18.22 on the bench and Juwan Johnson 1.2 in the lineup. Players he brought in by trade or off the wire have started for 332.1 points, the most in the league. Breece Hall was set to be limited in practice Wednesday, a first step back from the quad injury, and Emeka Egbuka did individual drills. Johnson and McCaffrey are on bye in week 8: two pieces to replace. His two previous 4-3 starts made the playoffs, and last year's reached the final.
managers.next: Week 8: butterygoop. TuanonStan leads the series 5-3 and has about a one-in-four chance.

managers.text: Trailed Wallner by 24.30 going into Monday night and won by 5.38, the closest game of the week. Dak Prescott (23.28), Quinshon Judkins (22.9) and Emanuel Wilson (18.0) led the lineup. Mason Taylor scored 22.7 on his bench, part of 38.3 points left there, the most of the week, and Mark Andrews started for 3.8. His two previous 4-3 starts, in 2023 and 2024, made the playoffs.

142.20 against triccster, the high score of the week, behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba (26.8), Tee Higgins (23.8) and Jameson Williams (23.6). Higgins has 85.6 started points since the preseason trade. Two straight wins after four straight losses, five weeks above the median and the fourth-most points in the league. He claimed Zonovan Knight for $6 and started him for 7.8. The model has moved him to 63%, tied for fifth.
managers.next: Week 8: DMsourbeer, who leads the series 3-2. Colt is a 74% favorite.

managers.text: Beat TuanonStan 125.06 to 107.52, his best score of the season, behind Drake Maye (27.44), Trey McBride (22.1) and Luther Burden (21.7). Michael Penix scored 20.42 on the bench. He has the hottest hand in the league, 107.1 a week over the last three against 96.0 for the season, and the most points left on the bench all year (224.7). His one previous 3-4 start, last year, missed the playoffs. The model has him at 13%.
managers.next: Week 8: triccster, who leads the series 4-1. RebuildingRUs is at 32%.

tags.t: Most points left on the bench

managers.text: 2-5 with the fifth-most points in the league (836.68). The latest was 119.84 to 112.72 to butterygoop, with Derrick Henry scoring 5.4 and Christian Watson 8.2. Javonte Williams (21.5), Kirk Cousins (20.4) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.7) led it, and Caleb Douglas had 20.0 on the bench. One free agent would have flipped it (see the moves). The model has him at 34%.
managers.next: Week 8: Wallner, who won last year's meeting 117.52 to 85.88. thecreamer leads the series 5-3 and is a 61% favorite.

managers.text: Seven weeks, none above the median, and the fewest points in the league (587.02). Lost 95.68 to 76.30 to TrifectaRich, the quietest score of the week. Bucky Irving (23.5) and Cam Skattebo (18.6) led the lineup; Tyjae Spears started and scored 0.0. The model gives him a 25% chance at last place.
managers.next: Week 8: Colt45Johnson. DMsourbeer leads the series 3-2 and is at 26%.

managers.text: Lost a game he led going into Monday night for the second straight week, 119.28 to 113.90 to YoungBuck04. Tony Pollard scored 35.0, the best player of the week, and Bo Nix added 26.18. Aaron Jones left with a knee injury and scored 3.1; he did not practice Wednesday and is day-to-day. Tyrone Tracy went on injured reserve with a hamstring injury. The same free agent would have flipped this one too. Devaughn Vele has started all seven weeks for 69.3, still the best pickup of the season. No 1-6 team in league history has made the playoffs.

Beat Jbird531 92.54 to 78.66 for his first win, behind Joe Burrow (28.88), Colston Loveland (16.4) and Tucker Kraft (12.8). He holds the most draft capital in the league, 7 firsts and 17 picks from 2027 to 2029, and De'Von Achane is still on injured reserve. The model gives him a 50% chance at last place.
managers.next: Week 8: TrifectaRich, the game of the week. He has won four straight in the series and is at 42%.

moves.intro: No new trades in week 7. Two waiver claims and one free agent who would have changed two games.

items.title: The same tight end, twice
items.text: Davis Allen scored 16.0 while unrostered that week. In for Darnell Washington (6.9), he flips thecreamer's 7.12-point loss to butterygoop; in for Dallas Goedert (7.3), he flips Wallner's 5.38-point loss to YoungBuck04.
items.verdict: thecreamer's second wire flip of the season, level with brettmn13 and Colt45Johnson.

items.title: Knight for $6
items.text: Colt45Johnson claimed Zonovan Knight for $6, dropping Marquise Brown, and started him right away.
items.verdict: His bye week is week 10, when D'Andre Swift and Caleb Williams are both off.

items.title: The hurt running back trade, three weeks on
items.text: Neither Breece Hall nor De'Von Achane has played since the week 5 swap. Hall missed his fourth straight game on Sunday and was set to be limited in practice Wednesday. Achane is on injured reserve.
items.verdict: Still a bet on the spring for both of them.

trends.title: What seven weeks means here
trends.text: Every 6-1 team in league history has made the playoffs, six of six, and five won the title. 5-2 teams made it 92% of the time, 4-3 teams 74%, 3-4 teams 24% and 2-5 teams 12%.

trends.title: Scoring
trends.text: Week 7 averaged 108.7 a team, back up from 102.2 a week earlier.

history.title: Week 7, all time
history.text: The highest week 7 score on record is thecreamer's 175.66 in 2020. The biggest week 7 margin is Jbird531's 158.92 to 60.42 over DMsourbeer in 2024. The closest is triccster over Colt45Johnson, 85.78 to 84.42, in 2022.

ahead: Game of the week: brettmn13 and TrifectaRich. brettmn13 has won four straight in the series, and TrifectaRich plays without three starters. Also on the board: Jbird531 and YoungBuck04 in a rematch of last year's semifinal, and butterygoop against TuanonStan, who leads that series.

nfl.intro: Wallner loses Tyrone Tracy to injured reserve and has Aaron Jones day-to-day, butterygoop gets Josh Jacobs back and may get Lamar Jackson back, and triccster's Saquon Barkley came out of his return banged up.

items.headline: Giants place RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR with hamstring injury
items.note: Wallner's Tyrone Tracy is on injured reserve, and the Giants are on bye this week. DMsourbeer has Cam Skattebo and TrifectaRich has Devin Singletary, the backs who are left.

items.headline: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Bengals; Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley to start
items.note: butterygoop's Lamar Jackson missed week 7. Colt45Johnson has Tyler Huntley, who scored 15.12 on his bench.

items.headline: Ravens' Jesse Minter optimistic QB Lamar Jackson can return vs. Bills
Kirk Cousins to remain Raiders' starting QB vs. Jets, Klint Kubiak says
items.note: thecreamer keeps his starter. TuanonStan has Fernando Mendoza, the Raiders' backup.

items.headline: Baker Mayfield returns for Bucs, but WR Emeka Egbuka, RT Luke Goedeke out
items.note: brettmn13's Baker Mayfield is back. TuanonStan's Emeka Egbuka missed week 7 with concussion and foot injuries.

items.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley says hamstring 'great' in return, not sweating back issue
items.note: triccster's Barkley had 62 yards and a touchdown on seven carries on Monday night.

items.headline: Packers activate RB Josh Jacobs for 2026 debut
items.note: butterygoop's Jacobs had 11 carries for 36 yards and a receiving touchdown in his first game.

items.headline: Vikings RB Jones avoids serious knee injury, day-to-day
items.note: RebuildingRUs has Jordan Mason, who took over when Jones left.
